headline: Global Trade Partners Push Back Against New US Tariffs of Up to 20%
summary: President Donald Trump unveiled new tariffs of up to 20% targeting 14 trading partners, including China, the EU, India, and Japan, prompting strong international opposition.
why: Broad tariff escalations disrupt international supply chains, raise import costs for industrial inputs, and risk retaliatory trade measures that impact global equities.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: New trade tariffs increase corporate cost burdens and spark fears of retaliatory measures, rattling equity markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Imposition of broad tariffs across major trading partners increased macroeconomic uncertainty and inflationary concerns, triggering broad market pullbacks.
